mapper.insert: INSERT INTO job_favorite (candidate_id, job_id, created_at) VALUES (#{candidateId}, #{jobId}, #{createdAt})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM job_favorite WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND job_id = #{jobId}
mapper.select: SELECT f.job_id AS jobId, j.title AS title, j.industry_group_code AS industryGroupCode, j.industry_code AS industryCode, j.city_code AS cityCode, j.city_name AS cityName, j.salary_min_amount AS salaryMinAmount, j.salary_max_amount AS salaryMaxAmount, j.salary_currency AS salaryCurrency, j.salary_period AS salaryPeriod, j.salary_months AS salaryMonths, j.is_salary_negotiable AS salaryNegotiable, j.salary_raw_text AS salaryRawText, j.min_experience_years AS minExperienceYears, j.education_requirement AS educationRequirement, j.published_at AS publishedAt, f.created_at AS favoritedAt, CASE WHEN j.id IS NULL OR j.deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS deleted, CASE WHEN j.id IS NULL OR j.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR j.status <> 'PUBLISHED' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS is_offline FROM job_favorite f LEFT JOIN job_post j ON j.id = f.job_id WHERE f.candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC
SELECT job_id FROM job_favorite WHERE candidate_id = #{candidateId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
